message.content:
This is a screenshot of an **interactive educational simulation application** for a chemical engineering process called **"Flash Separation"**. The interface is designed for learning, with a dark theme and a clean, modern layout.

Here is a detailed breakdown of the screen:

### 1. Top Header & Navigation
*   **Title Bar (Top Left):** Displays "**Flash Separation**" with a "**BEGINNER**" tag next to it. Below this is a subtitle: "First flowsheet • 3 units • 4 streams • teaches phase separation".
*   **Navigation Buttons (Top Right):** Three pill-shaped buttons labeled "**Explore**", "**Operate**", and "**Learn**". The "Explore" button appears to be active (white background). To the right of these is a settings/gear icon.

### 2. Main Canvas / Plant Diagram (Center)
The central area displays a simplified process flow diagram (PFD) on a dark gray background.
*   **Instructional Text:** At the very top of this panel, it says: "*Drag to pan • scroll to zoom • click any unit or stream*".
*   **Unit F-101 (Left):** A rounded square icon containing a circle with a horizontal line through it (representing a vessel/feed tank). It is labeled:
    *   **F-101**
    *   **SYNGAS FEED**
    *   This unit has a slightly lighter gray background highlight.
*   **Stream 1 (Connecting Arrow):** A light blue arrow connects F-101 to E-101. There is a circular badge on the line containing the number "**1**".
*   **Unit E-101 (Right):** An icon representing a heat exchanger or chiller (a rectangle with one rounded end and internal dashed lines). It is labeled:
    *   **E-101**
    *   **CHILLER**

### 3. Narration/Script Panel (Right Side)
A floating panel is open on the right side of the screen, providing context for the current step in the lesson.
*   **Header:**
    *   A progress indicator showing "**1 / 7**" with a blue progress bar above it.
    *   An '**X**' close button in the top right corner.
*   **Title:** "**One stream becomes two**"
*   **Subtitle:** "**The delivery arrives**"
*   **Body Text:** "Synthesis gas enters at the battery limit: hydrogen and nitrogen at 3:1, carrying about 12% ammonia vapor plus some inert methane and argon. At 30 °C and 140 bar it is all gas — no liquid anywhere. The mission: recover the ammonia as a pure liquid."
*   **Audio Controls:** Below the text are toggle buttons for "**VOICE**" (active/blue) and "**MUSIC**" (active/teal), followed by a refresh/replay icon.
*   **Status Text:** Small italicized text reads: "*Narrating — music lowers while I speak.*"

### 4. Bottom Controls & Legend
*   **Bottom Left Legend:** Shows stream types with colored lines:
    *   **PROCESS GAS** (Gray)
    *   **LOOP GAS** (Blue)
    *   **PRODUCT** (Green/Teal)
    *   There is also a compass rose icon showing "**N**" for North.
*   **Zoom Controls (Bottom Center-Right):** A control cluster with minus (**-**), plus (**+**), and "**FIT**" buttons to adjust the canvas view.
*   **Navigation Footer (Bottom Right):**
    *   A text button: "**← Back**"
    *   A large, prominent white button: "**Next →**"

**Summary:** The user is currently on step 1 of 7 in a beginner tutorial for a Flash Separation process. They are viewing the feed section (F-101 to E-101) while reading narration that explains the composition and state of the incoming synthesis gas.
